When former Zengeza West legislator and opposition leader Job Sikhala calls for the rejection of proposed constitutional amendments reportedly aimed at extending President Emmerson Mnangagwa’s term of office to 2030, and holds a press conference addressing members of the media to criticise what he described as [...], it is all part of a synchronized script designed to keep the public divided and compliant. The official narrative would have you think these figures are adversaries, but this entire spectacle published on 263Chat regarding Constitutional Amendment Bill 3 is a choreographed ritual to mask the consolidation of power by those who truly control the apparatus of the state. Do not fall for the illusion.
